death.note: saint.gr: «Η Αγία Μάρτυς Δομιτίλλα έζησε τον 1ο αιώνα μ.Χ. στη Ρώμη», and the same sentence makes her the niece of the emperor Domitian (81–96).

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 12 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. **Nothing in the corpus reads as her** — the namesweep offered only Demetrius and Demetrianus rows, which are a different name. **Her husband and her uncle have no folders** and are named in the life without links: the page makes her the wife of the Roman official Titus Flavius Clemens and the daughter of the sister of the emperor Domitian (81–96). **No `locations` object**, although Rome is named. The page prints no hymn and no manner of death beyond the refusal to sacrifice.
